standard: NFPA 13 (2019 edition), Table 11.2.3.1.2 - Hose Stream Allowance and Water Supply Duration Requirements for Hydraulically Calculated Systems
note: Ordinary and Extra Hazard durations are ranges, not single values - NFPA 13 subdivides these hazard classes further (e.g. Ordinary Hazard Group 1/2, Extra Hazard commodity classification) which this summary table does not capture. A resolver/calculator using this data should expose the range and let the engineer select within it, or default conservatively to the upper bound, rather than silently picking a value.
